bug_1: Alert rule required 2+ drifted features, silently missing a severe single-feature shift (amount, p=0.00003). Fixed with a dual condition: strong single-feature evidence (p<0.001) OR multiple corroborating features (2+, p<0.05).
limitation_1: KS test on 'hour' cannot detect a circular/modular shift (+6h wraparound) because a uniform distribution shifted circularly remains uniform in marginal terms — confirmed via direct inspection, not a bug in the detector. Would need a circular-statistics test to catch this specific failure mode.
